headlines.snippet: The Trump administration is urging the Supreme Court to permit restrictions on mail-in voting before the midterms. This is a key legal battle.

headlines.title: Deadly Ukrainian drone strikes hit Russia
headlines.snippet: Deadly Ukrainian drone strikes have hit Russia. The attacks represent a significant escalation in the ongoing conflict.
